copy.name: ALGAL
copy.promise: Write agent programs that wait, resume, and replay.
open: A program can wait before it acts.
Save the work, then resume when the decision arrives.

steps.heading: Start
steps.body: The demo program stops before it acts, with status waiting.

steps.heading: Decide
steps.body: The report page names the one action. You approve or deny it.

steps.heading: Crash
steps.body: Killed twice on purpose. Finished steps are reused, and an uncertain write is not resent.

steps.heading: Verify
steps.body: Export the run to one file and check its history offline.

proof.caption: Counts from a recorded run of algal demo prove.

limits.heading: Runtime and host
limits.body: Keep the local store to resume a run. Your app chooses the tools and permissions a program receives.
